description: In front there’s a bed-like surface with a closed laptop in the middle, an open notebook and pen on the left, and a cardboard box on the right along with a paper cup, a small packet, a bottle, and some clothes. The left hand and right hand together lift and hold the cardboard box, then the right hand picks up the paper cup and drops it into the box, followed by the right hand grabbing the blue packet and placing it inside; the right hand then picks up the bottle and lowers it into the box, and both hands continue gathering the orange shirt and green garment and stuffing them into the box before sliding the now-filled box to the right edge.
